## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue or upstream component when relevant.

## Renderer and accessibility impact

Describe React/Astro behavior, any hydration requirement, and keyboard or screen-reader changes. Include a Storybook example or screenshots for visual changes.

## Validation

List checks run and any known limitations.

- [ ] Source and shared variants are updated; generated output was rebuilt locally.
- [ ] Both renderers are verified where supported, and differences are documented.
- [ ] Storybook examples and meaningful regression checks cover the change.
- [ ] Package exports, dependencies, and third-party notices are updated when applicable.
